page.subtitle: Hurricane Isaias made landfall on the Florida Panhandle on October 9, 2026, bringing storm surge, damaging winds and inland flooding to Florida and Alabama.
page.intro:
Hurricane Isaias came ashore near Pensacola, Florida, as a Category 3 storm on October 9, 2026, pushing a storm surge of up to 9 feet into Escambia and Mobile Bays. Forecasters described the rainfall as "a slow-moving flood event" as the storm stalled over southern Alabama for nearly two days.

NASA's Disasters Program is providing optical, radar and nighttime-lights imagery to help response agencies map flood extent, assess coastal damage and track power outages across the affected counties.
